assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production transparent sprite atlas for Nuvori. Input is an identity reference containing 25 distinct creatures in 5 columns by 5 rows. Make exactly 50 new full-body drawings, preserving every creature's individual design, color, age, appendages, anatomy and illustrated detailed game art. Output a large landscape atlas, ideally 3200x1600, EXACTLY 10 columns by 5 rows. Every reference cell expands into TWO adjacent cells in its same row: first a true RIGHT-FACING PROFILE (nose points right, visible flank), second a true REAR view (back toward viewer, looking up/away, NO visible face or eyes). Thus output columns 1/2 are views of reference column1, 3/4 reference column2, etc. Reference row order unchanged. All 25 creatures must appear twice. Same scale and ground baseline for both views. Preserve original silhouettes; do not invent species or repeat one in another's cell. Crisp fine dark outlines, richly shaded polished illustrated fantasy creature sprites exactly matching reference. Orthographic game camera with slight top-down angle, no perspective scene. Each sprite including tails/wings/glows must fit inside its own cell with at least 15% EMPTY TRANSPARENT padding on all sides. No touching, no cell borders, no floor, no lettering, no background, true transparent alpha. Front views are NOT requested. These are NEW side and back drawings for the provided creatures.
